overview_description.description: Mamahood is a femtech app that focuses on women's physical and mental wellness during their reproductive, pregnancy, and postpartum years. Mamahood also includes medical advice and emotional support. At Mamahood, we're driven by a deep commitment to holistic women & family wellness. Mamahood offers a 360-degree approach to family health, covering everything from fertility planning and pregnancy care to parenting support and beyond. We understand that a corporation's success is closely tied to the well-being of its employees. Our Corporate Solutions are designed to promote a culture of health and wellness in your workplace, supporting women & and families through every stage of their journey.
